From: quality department

Dear Professor,
AeroCompo Tunisia is a 300-employee subsidiary producing carbon-fibre interior panels and
cabin brackets for regional aircraft. Our plant is
located in the El Mghira aeronautics park.

- Over the last two quarters, our first-pass yield on autoclave-cured panels dropped from 93% to 84%.
- Most rejects show porosity detected by ultrasonic inspection.
- We suspect inconsistent vacuum bagging or a drift in the autoclave temperature profile.
